chapter: Records, rivals and New Orleans bands
title: Pay for dance jobs
summary: Punch says pay began at two or two and a half dollars a man and reached five dollars when he left.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: Would you get a percentage on the gate there in those halls?

No, they just paid us maybe two dollars a man or two and a half, something like that. That was the beginning. Then they come up around five dollars a man. When I left the yard, that's what they was giving me, five dollars a man. The leader gets sick. Dollars worth of aspirin? Well it must have been something like that because they wouldn't have to do that the else way.
